policy_source_edit.reason: WHATWG URL normalization already collapses all decimal/hex/octal/abbreviated loopback host forms (2130706433, 0x7f000001, 0x7f.0.0.1, 127.1, 0177.0.0.1) to 127.0.0.1, which is absent from the reviewed allowlist; [::1], fe80::1 (and all IPv6/link-local) are likewise excluded. request_count_proof: For every forbidden target, a direct counting fetchImpl throws if ever reached and the assertion requires marks[key]===0 — i.e. the request never reaches the seam. Each direct private/RFC1918/link-local/metadata/broadcast/IPv6-non-global family is asserted at BOTH the http scheme boundary and the https host boundary (f1 HTTPS host-boundary). Redirect-to-private/encoded/IPv6-link-local cases assert exactly one first-hop fetch to the allowlisted public host and zero second-hop/forbidden fetches. The single happy-path asserts exactly one allowed fetch.
